# No Stairs Please

> No Stairs Please is a live music venue database and talent-booking directory covering 38,223 open small and mid-size live music venues across 10,286 towns in all 50 US states, the District of Columbia, and British Columbia as of 2026-11-11. The directory tracks 7,325 verified talent-booking contacts separated from general inquiry lines, 7,636 rooms with known capacity of 500 or under, 90-day live show activity meters, usual music nights, and an OAuth 2.1 Model Context Protocol server at https://nostairsplease.com/mcp.

## Core pages

- [Live Music Venue Directory](https://nostairsplease.com/venues): Interactive directory and route map of 38,223 open live music venues across all 50 US states, DC, and British Columbia.
- [Use with AI and MCP Server](https://nostairsplease.com/mcp): Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any Model Context Protocol client to https://nostairsplease.com/mcp for route-corridor venue search, performer show history, and booking contacts.
- [All Access Pricing](https://nostairsplease.com/all-access): One-time All Access passes at $25 for one month or $200 for one year with zero recurring subscriptions, plus free account reveals.
- [About No Stairs Please](https://nostairsplease.com/about): Who built No Stairs Please, and what it shows for each small venue.
- [Contact](https://nostairsplease.com/contact): Direct contact details for venue updates, booking contact corrections, and support.

## Musician booking resources

- [Musician Booking Resources Hub](https://nostairsplease.com/resources): Data-backed guides, templates, and outreach playbooks for independent bands and solo performers.
- [EPK Template & Electronic Press Kit Examples for Bands](https://nostairsplease.com/resources/epk-template): Copy-paste HTML and Markdown EPK and band one-sheet templates grounded in submission rules across verified venue booking routes.
- [Stage Plot & Input List Template for Solo Acts and Bands](https://nostairsplease.com/resources/stage-plot-template): Printable stage plot, input list, and hospitality rider templates built from documented stage and PA equipment records.
- [How to Get Music Gigs as a Solo Performer or Independent Band](https://nostairsplease.com/resources/how-to-get-gigs): Category-by-category outreach playbook for booking bars, music venues, breweries, restaurants, wineries, and coffee shops.
- [How to Book a DIY Music Tour & Route Corridors](https://nostairsplease.com/resources/how-to-book-a-music-tour): Step-by-step tour routing guide across regional drive-time areas and highway corridors using No Stairs Please and the MCP server.
- [Band Booking Email Templates for Talent Buyers & Venue Managers](https://nostairsplease.com/resources/booking-email-templates): Ready-to-send pitch email templates for dedicated music club talent buyers, brewery taproom managers, and hold-challenge follow-ups.
- [How Much Do Venues Pay Bands? Guarantees, Door Splits & Bar Cuts](https://nostairsplease.com/resources/how-much-do-venues-pay-bands): Empirical breakdown of flat guarantees, door splits, bar percentages, and tip-jar terms compiled from reviewed venue pay records.
- [Indie on the Move Alternative: Live Music Venue Database Comparison](https://nostairsplease.com/resources/indie-on-the-move-alternative): Feature and coverage comparison across venue counts, separated talent-booking contacts, 90-day show activity meters, MCP tools, and one-time pricing.

## National venue category hubs

- [Small Music Venues](https://nostairsplease.com/venues/type/small-music-venues): 7,636 open venues across the US and British Columbia, including 2,306 with verified talent-booking contacts and 5,025 with active 90-day show schedules.
- [Bars with Live Music](https://nostairsplease.com/venues/type/bars-with-live-music): 4,487 open venues across the US and British Columbia, including 1,092 with verified talent-booking contacts and 2,723 with active 90-day show schedules.
- [Breweries with Live Music](https://nostairsplease.com/venues/type/breweries-with-live-music): 2,084 open venues across the US and British Columbia, including 569 with verified talent-booking contacts and 1,429 with active 90-day show schedules.
- [Wineries with Live Music](https://nostairsplease.com/venues/type/wineries-with-live-music): 1,440 open venues across the US and British Columbia, including 229 with verified talent-booking contacts and 978 with active 90-day show schedules.
- [Listening Rooms & Acoustic Venues](https://nostairsplease.com/venues/type/listening-rooms): 158 open venues across the US and British Columbia, including 73 with verified talent-booking contacts and 128 with active 90-day show schedules.
- [Live Music Venues with Open Mic Nights](https://nostairsplease.com/venues/type/open-mic-nights): 2,070 open venues across the US and British Columbia, including 790 with verified talent-booking contacts and 1,669 with active 90-day show schedules.

# No Stairs Please

> No Stairs Please is a live music venue database and talent-booking directory covering 38,223 open small and mid-size live music venues across 10,286 towns in all 50 US states, the District of Columbia, and British Columbia as of 2026-11-11. The directory tracks 7,325 verified talent-booking contacts separated from general inquiry lines, 7,636 rooms with known capacity of 500 or under, 90-day live show activity meters, usual music nights, and an OAuth 2.1 Model Context Protocol server at https://nostairsplease.com/mcp.

## Core pages

- [Live Music Venue Directory](https://nostairsplease.com/venues): Interactive directory and route map of 38,223 open live music venues across all 50 US states, DC, and British Columbia.
- [Use with AI and MCP Server](https://nostairsplease.com/mcp): Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any Model Context Protocol client to https://nostairsplease.com/mcp for route-corridor venue search, performer show history, and booking contacts.
- [All Access Pricing](https://nostairsplease.com/all-access): One-time All Access passes at $25 for one month or $200 for one year with zero recurring subscriptions, plus free account reveals.

- [Contact](https://nostairsplease.com/contact): Direct contact details for venue updates, booking contact corrections, and support.

VenuesPricesSign in

Every small stage in the US, and who books it.

Music nights, booking contacts, room capacity and show history at small and mid-size venues, for musicians who book their own shows.

Get started for freeNo card needed All Access · $25No subscription

38,223 venues10,286 towns7,325 custom booking routesUpdated Nov 11, 2026

See which nights have music.

Each weekday gets a meter from the venue’s own schedule and its listed shows. Regular nights stand out before you write a pitch.

Find the busy rooms on the map.

Each icon shows the kind of room, colored by its show days in 90 days, red for 15 or more. Zoom from the state into a neighborhood and click between rooms to compare capacity, music days, photos, booking contacts, room details and the bands that play there. Holocene is a 312-capacity music venue on Portland’s east side, five blocks from Swan Dive PDX.

Who to pitch, and what the room wants.

Booking emails and pages sit apart from general and rental contacts, above the room’s requirements, capacity and act format. Eruption solicits solo and duo acts with original music.

Draw a route and see every room along it.

Click your stops on the map. The directory follows the road between them and keeps the venues within the distance you pick, from 10 to 200 miles. Seattle to Bozeman on I-90 is 683 road miles, with 470 venues within 10 miles of the road.

See who already plays there.

Click an act on a venue page to see every venue in the directory where it has played or is booked. Hal Waldram is listed at Eruption on October 10. The artist page counts 14 shows at 5 Idaho venues.

Start free or pay once. No subscriptions.

# Site & Map UI Guidance

- Read [../DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md) for the studio hardware palette, typography, and component rules shared by `site/` and `/mcp-app.html`.
- **Header and footer protection**: Never add, remove, rename, or rearrange links or content in the site `<header>` (`<nav aria-label="Main">`) or `<footer class="site-footer">` (or inject new homepage/footer sections) without asking and getting express permission from the user first.
- **Map zoom and camera stability (`site/app.js`, `site/shared.js`)**: Never programmatically change the map zoom or center (`fitBounds`, `flyTo`, `jumpTo`, `render(true)`, `renderMarkers(true)`) unless the user explicitly asks (such as clicking "Show all on map" `[data-fit-map]`) or performs a location-selecting navigation action where moving the camera to that place is the intent of the action (such as choosing a State or Area in `#region` or selecting a town in `#near` / `#to`).
- Actions that filter or edit in place (clearing a route with `Clear route`, drawing or finishing a route on the map canvas, adding a leg, toggling category/capacity/day/favorites filters, removing filter chips, clearing all filters, typing a text search, or switching between List and Map views after initial camera placement) must call `render(false)` / `renderMarkers(false)` and preserve the user's current map zoom and center.
- **Clean URLs (`site/venue-view.js`, `src/build/seo-build.ts`, `src/worker/worker-seo.ts`, `src/worker/worker.ts`)**: Never use `.html` extensions or `?id=` query parameters in internal links, canonicals, sitemaps, or UI routes:
  - Venue pages: `/venues/<state>/<city-slug>/<venue-slug>` (`VenueView.venuePath(venue)`), with 301 redirects from `/venue.html?id=<id>`, `/venues/<id>`, and `/venues/<city>(-<state>)/<venue-slug>`.
  - Artist pages: `/artists/<name>` (`VenueView.actUrl(name)`), served by `site/artist.html` with 301 redirects from `/artist.html?name=<name>` and `/artist?name=<name>`.
  - Directory and hubs: `/venues`, `/venues/<state>`, `/venues/<state>/<city-slug>`, `/venues/<state>/<city-slug>/<modifier>`, `/venues/type/<type-slug>`.
  - Static and account pages: `/all-access`, `/login`, `/account`, `/consent`, `/about`, `/mcp`, `/contact`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/resources`, `/resources/<slug>` (legacy `/*.html` paths 301-redirect to clean extensionless paths).
- **Performer search (`site/performer-search.js`)**: Shared by the website (`site/artist.html` at `/artists/<name>`, `site/app.js` at `/venues`) and the `/mcp` Worker (`worker-mcp.ts`). Run `bun test ./golden-set/performer-search.test.ts` (against [`../golden-set/performer-search.json`](../golden-set/performer-search.json)) whenever editing `site/performer-search.js`.
- **End-to-end UI, Worker, and `/mcp` verification**: Read [../.agents/skills/verify-nostairsplease/SKILL.md](../.agents/skills/verify-nostairsplease/SKILL.md) and run the verification harness (`bun run verify:local launch`, `python3 .agents/skills/verify-nostairsplease/scripts/verify-journey.py all`, `bun run verify:local cleanup`) to verify directory, map camera invariants, venue reveals, performer search, and `/mcp` widget flows across `anon`, `free`, and `paid` tiers.
